curation: 16 manually classified, known relevant arXiv papers from the existing relevance seed. Publication CALENDAR dates cross-checked against arXiv abstracts for previously unobserved papers. Selection is not representative or independent of previous discovery.
assessment_policy: Measure within-lookback known-item hit rate at per-source depths K=25,50,100; report missed IDs and pagination caps. This is not full-corpus retrieval recall.
